subject: Quick follow-up: account sponsor, procurement & security touchpoints
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novumai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novumai.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: account sponsor, procurement & security touchpoints

Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion about how NovumAI wants to reduce per-token inference spend while keeping latency predictable for your chat product. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key decision criteria we heard: predictable latency at 99th pct, cost per 1M tokens, and SLO-backed availability for peak trading hours.
- Pilot ask: 2-week evaluation with 1 GPU-dedicated instance + streaming endpoints, sampling 50k tokens/day.

Immediate asks for your side (so we can assemble the mutual action plan):
1) Who is the economic buyer / final signatory for vendor contracts at NovumAI? (name + email)
2) Procurement contact for vendor paperwork and PO process
3) Security owner who will handle the vendor security questionnaire and any SOC2 evidence requests

I attached a short Redwood brief and a stub showing the SOC2 artifacts we typically provide. If you can introduce the buyer/procurement/security owners on this thread, we’ll propose a short MAP and a 30-min alignment call.

Proposed times (PT): Thu 4/29 10:00-10:30, Thu 4/29 14:00-14:30, Fri 4/30 11:00-11:30 — happy to adjust.

Attachments: Redwood-brief.pdf (1 page), SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf (listing of docs we can share under NDA)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for engineering teams
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novumai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novumai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: account sponsor, procurement & security touchpoints

Thanks Jasmine — good call on our side as well. Quick answers to your asks: 

- Economic buyer / signing authority: Elena Morales (VP Product) <elena.morales@novumai.com> — she owns vendor spend over $50k annual run-rate.
- Procurement contact: procurement@novumai.com (this inbox is managed by our vendor ops specialist).
- Security: our InfoSec lead will coordinate the questionnaire; initial contact is sec-requests@novumai.com (cc'd on my internal thread; adding below once I confirm).

I attached our vendor intake form (Novum_vendor_form.pdf) — it has our standard fields and preferred contract language. Pricing request: can you share a short spreadsheet with pilot pricing (commit level, burst, and overage)? Also helpful to see an example SLA and SSO/SAML options.

Happy to do the alignment call — Elena is available Thu 4/29 14:00-14:30 PT if that works for your team.

Alex
Head of Partnerships | NovumAI
alex.carter@novumai.com

Attachments: Novum_vendor_form.pdf
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novumai.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumai.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>, Procurement Team <procurement@novumai.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: account sponsor, procurement & security touchpoints

Appreciate the quick reply and the intro, Alex — welcome Elena (copied).

To keep this tight, proposed plan:
- 30-min kickoff (alignment + MAP) Thu 4/29 14:00 PT (per Alex) — we'll send a calendar invite if that slot is confirmed.
- We’ll share a 1-page pilot SOW and a pricing worksheet that shows a committed monthly baseline, burst blocks, and overage unit pricing.
- Security: we can provide the SOC2 package and a data flow diagram within 48 hours under NDA; Connor (cc) will own the security packet and can jump on the call.

Connor / Grace — can you: 
- Attach the pilot pricing sheet to the calendar invite (I’ve uploaded it here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-pricing)
- Prep a 1-page SOW template and the MAP template. I’ve attached the MAP_template.xlsx as a starter.

Elena / Procurement Team — any constraints on contract terms we should know up front (PO lead time, standard redline clauses, data residency requirements)? If you prefer, Procurement can send the preferred PO instructions and timeline and we’ll mirror that on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_template.xlsx
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novumai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: account sponsor, procurement & security touchpoints

On Thu, Apr 28, 2027 at 09:17 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion about how NovumAI wants to reduce per-token inference spend while keeping latency predictable for your chat product. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Thanks for the summary. A few housekeeping items from procurement ops: 

1) Preferred PO process: we issue a PO once pricing and SOW are agreed; typical lead time is ~10 business days after receipt of final invoice and signed SOW.
2) Contract routing: please send your standard MSA + SOW; legal@novumai.com will handle redlines.
3) Data residency: primary requirement is EU and US region availability; no on-prem requirement at this time.
4) Target internal sign date: week of 2027-05-17 to enable Q2 pilot.

Please send the MSA/SOW and we’ll circulate to legal. Attached are our PO_instructions.pdf and a brief note on standard redline positions.

Procurement Team
NovumAI
procurement@novumai.com

Attachments: PO_instructions.pdf
